messages.subject: For José Manuel Entrecanales | Sustainable infrastructure, government relations and ESG execution
messages.body:
Dear ACCIONA Investor Relations Team,

Please place this executive introduction before Mr. José Manuel Entrecanales, Chairman and Chief Executive Officer.

ACCIONA's sustainable infrastructure, renewable-energy and water businesses operate at the intersection of governments, communities, environmental commitments and complex project execution. Those priorities align strongly with my current mandate.

I serve as Liaison Director, Social Responsibility Department at AGM Inc., part of Zijin Mining Group. My responsibilities span government and regulatory relations, ESG, corporate affairs, strategic partnerships and executive advisory. I coordinate senior institutional engagement and complex stakeholder matters across corporate and technical functions, while supporting governance around a large industrial solar and battery-storage platform and a carbon-accounting evidence pilot.

I would welcome a senior conversation about where this combination of government relations, ESG, stakeholder strategy and sustainable-infrastructure experience might support ACCIONA's international priorities. My attached CV has been tailored specifically to ACCIONA.

Kind regards,
Ragunauth Ramsaroop
Liaison Director, Social Responsibility Department | AGM Inc.
